description: Image Description: The image shows a display of kitchen appliances on metal shelves. The top shelf has three stand mixers in silver, red, and black colors, each with a mixing bowl attached. There are also some booklets or brochures, one of which appears to be a cookbook and another related to gift giving. The middle shelf contains additional stand mixers in pink and silver, with metallic bowls. The bottom shelf features electric kettles in silver and black designs, along with a boxed item on the right side
